approach: I loaded the requirement-steps skill for REQ-08 and read the four contracted inputs: the approved PRD, prototype and TRD, plus org.templates. To ground the tasks and boundary criteria I also read the existing unit test files in ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_aging, and predict.py in ap_forecast. I split the work into one epic and five features, one feature per repository and lane following the TRD routing. Under them are eight stories in NEW state, each with tasks. Every story follows the template (ID, title, As a/I want/So that, Gherkin acceptance criteria, assumptions, open items) and also gives PRD/TRD traces, frame links, dependencies and a specification depth. Frame links point to the prototype's text frames (SC-1, WF-1, WF-2, flows 4.1 and 4.2), because Figma is not connected. Interim TRD designs that depend on an open question are written as acceptance criteria marked [Pending <ID>]. I set no priority or estimate, because that is not a Requirement agent action. A verifier subagent checked the draft and found 11 issues: criteria that rest on open questions but had no marker, overstated wording, one uncited sentence, and one unsupported task. I fixed all of them. As a result every story is now D2, and I added a short note explaining why.
